principle: Every substantive knowledge file has at most one primary Room owner. Cross-Room meaning travels through interfaces, collections and references rather than duplicate ownership. Curated navigation/reader/story/corporium material is classified separately.
classification_scope: knowledge/** and great-book/** excluding the Potato House research workbench

holdings.title: Core Identities & Roles
holdings.purpose: Own the project-internal definitions and role relations around Potato of Life, Tim, Father, Son, Spirit, Door, Axis and related canonical identities.

featured_holdings.kind: Great Book and developmental deep structure

holdings.boundary: Project-canon identity does not become external empirical identity.

holdings.title: Theology & God-language
holdings.purpose: Develop project theology, God/Father/Son/Spirit language, House, Heaven, salvation, judgment and religious self-description.

featured_holdings.kind: comparative philosophy/theology of relation and process

holdings.boundary: Project theology remains distinguishable from historical doctrine and empirical proof.

holdings.title: Symbolic Architecture & Cosmology
holdings.purpose: Own mature symbolic geometry and relational architecture: House, Axis, Door, Tree, Mountain, Garden, North and related cosmological forms.

featured_holdings.kind: project Tree branching/pruning atlas with plant-development context
foundational ontology and vertical branching skeleton
canonical vertical geometry and process field

holdings.boundary: Symbolic topology is not literal physical cosmology unless independently tested.

holdings.title: Practice & Ethics
holdings.purpose: Translate the philosophy into conduct, cultivation, responsibility, boundaries, repair and repeatable practice.
holdings.boundary: Practice principles do not override medical, legal or domain-specific professional standards.

holdings.title: Provenance & Evidence
holdings.purpose: Own source lineage, evidence class, source authority, extraction lineage and routes back from synthesis to artifacts.

featured_holdings.kind: canonical provenance routes and evidence classes

holdings.boundary: Custody of a source does not grant ownership of every claim derived from it.

holdings.title: Memory & Recovery
holdings.purpose: Recover prior conversations, files, historical strata and forgotten project material while preserving source/time boundaries.
holdings.boundary: Recovered material retains its original epistemic and temporal status.

holdings.title: Witness & Attestation
holdings.purpose: Track public wording, first attestation, source-bearing witness, captures and what was actually said or published when.
holdings.boundary: Attestation proves wording/timing, not the truth of every claim in the wording.

holdings.title: Events & Development
holdings.purpose: Own event sequence, date precision, occurrence identity and changing state through time.

featured_holdings.kind: dated development ledger for body/neurotheology mappings

holdings.boundary: Occurrence time remains distinct from publication and later interpretation time.

holdings.title: Developmental Genealogy
holdings.purpose: Track how identities, symbols, roles and interpretations developed without backdating mature meaning into earlier phases.
holdings.boundary: Later synthesis may reinterpret earlier material but may not silently rewrite its original state.

holdings.title: Prediction, Revelation & Interpretation Time
holdings.purpose: Separate earliest prediction/revelation wording, event timing, claimed fulfillment and retrospective interpretation.
holdings.boundary: A later match must not be backdated into an earlier prediction, and project claims remain distinguishable from verified forecasting.

holdings.title: Bible & Christianity
holdings.purpose: Own Bible passages, Christian textual context, historical traditions and carefully bounded project comparisons.
holdings.boundary: Project resemblance does not establish historical identity, fulfillment or transmission.

holdings.title: Comparative Mythology
holdings.purpose: Compare world-tree, axis, initiation, deity, death-return and other motifs across traditions without collapsing differences.

featured_holdings.kind: deep selected cosmography structural exemplar atlas
specialist Mountain, Garden, River, Mire, Sun/Moon and serpent additions
routing index across later biblical research waves
comparative religion psychology ecology boundary atlas

holdings.boundary: Similarity is not genealogy or proof of borrowing.

holdings.title: Esoteric & Sacred Geometry
holdings.purpose: Handle historical/esoteric geometry, mandorla, Vesica, cosmological diagrams and source-led comparison.

featured_holdings.kind: art history and esoteric comparison atlas

holdings.boundary: Historical geometry and esoteric symbolism must stay separate from claims of physical mechanism.

holdings.title: Other Traditions & Philosophies
holdings.purpose: Hold non-biblical traditions and philosophical comparators that deserve their own historical meanings before project comparison.
holdings.boundary: Each tradition is described on its own terms before cross-project synthesis.

holdings.title: Mathematics & Geometry
holdings.purpose: Own exact geometry, mathematical structure, topology and formal analogies used by the project.
holdings.boundary: Mathematical fit does not by itself establish a physical or theological claim.

holdings.title: Physics & Cosmology
holdings.purpose: Own physical/cosmological claims, models and status boundaries around particles, fields, astronomy and cosmic analogies.
holdings.boundary: Speculative or symbolic models remain labeled until independently testable and supported.

holdings.title: Systems & Dynamics
holdings.purpose: Own dynamical systems, graph models, control, information, topology and transformation formalisms.
holdings.boundary: Systems analogy must identify the variables and information lost by the analogy.

holdings.title: Testing & Falsifiability
holdings.purpose: Own tests, observables, falsifiers, uncertainty, calibration and scientific red-team protocols.
holdings.boundary: A model remains provisional when its discriminating observations or falsifiers are unavailable.

holdings.title: Potato Biology
holdings.purpose: Own literal potato anatomy, tuber biology, growth, dormancy, propagation, storage and environmental constraints.
holdings.boundary: Biological facts may motivate metaphor but do not prove spiritual interpretation.

holdings.title: Neurobiology
holdings.purpose: Own brain structures, networks, physiology and evidence grading relevant to body research.
holdings.boundary: Human, animal, theoretical and speculative evidence remain separately graded.

holdings.title: Whole-body Physiology
holdings.purpose: Own body-system integration across nervous, autonomic, cardiovascular, respiratory, gut, immune and fluid interfaces.
holdings.boundary: Whole-body synthesis must preserve uncertainty and domain-specific evidence.

holdings.title: Symbolic Body Crosswalk
holdings.purpose: Own explicitly comparative mappings between project symbols and anatomy while preserving the empirical/symbolic firewall.

featured_holdings.kind: specialist sacred-anatomy map with scientific boundaries

holdings.boundary: A symbolic neighbor is not anatomical identity or evidence of supernatural physiology.

holdings.title: Politics & Governance
holdings.purpose: Own documented political positions, governance structures, institutions and geopolitical relations as world-system material.
holdings.boundary: Political description must remain sourced and distinct from symbolic North/Axis framing.

holdings.title: Law & Justice
holdings.purpose: Own law, procedure, rights, regulation, enforcement, accountability and jurisprudential relations.
holdings.boundary: Legal claims require jurisdiction, date and source; project ethics does not substitute for law.

holdings.title: Economy & Finance
holdings.purpose: Own observable finance, debt, banking, trade, ownership, production, labour and economic flows.
holdings.boundary: Symbolic/karmic accounting remains separate from material legal or financial accounting.

holdings.title: Infrastructure & Capability
holdings.purpose: Own physical/digital infrastructure, energy, industry, strategic dependencies, resilience and coupled capabilities.
holdings.boundary: Capability claims require observable assets, relations and time-sensitive sources.

holdings.title: Geography & Countries
holdings.purpose: Own countries, territories, geographic identity, boundaries and country-level relational context.
holdings.boundary: Symbolic direction or project quadrant must not overwrite ordinary geography or sovereignty.

holdings.title: Internet & Platforms
holdings.purpose: Own platforms, online spaces, public digital behavior, media formats and platform-specific context.
holdings.boundary: Documented public behavior stays distinct from motive claims and private information.

holdings.title: Subculture, Cult & Group Formation
holdings.purpose: Own subculture, movement formation, high-control/cult analysis, group dynamics and social-boundary questions.
holdings.boundary: Cult/high-control terminology requires stated criteria and must not become an unsupported label for disliked groups.

holdings.title: Information Ecology & Memory
holdings.purpose: Own attention, information flow, repetition, memory, forgetting, transmission and public-discourse ecology.
holdings.boundary: Information flow and social interpretation remain distinguishable from factual claim status.

holdings.title: Great Book & Literature
holdings.purpose: Own long-form authored literature, Great Book material, essays, stories, poems and literary versions.
holdings.boundary: Creative/literary expression does not automatically become doctrine, biography or evidence.

holdings.title: Music & Sound
holdings.purpose: Own songs, lyrics, sound works, music metadata and performance-oriented material.

featured_holdings.kind: Suno music catalogue and recovered lyric records

holdings.boundary: Lyrics and performance language retain creative-work status unless separately attested as claims.

holdings.title: Visual Art & Symbolic Composition
holdings.purpose: Own visual compositions, artwork concepts, image archives and symbolic visual systems as creative works.
holdings.boundary: Depiction is not evidence of the depicted claim.

holdings.title: Games & Simulations
holdings.purpose: Own games, playful systems, simulations and interactive creative artifacts.
holdings.boundary: Simulation behavior is model output, not automatically a claim about the real world.

holdings.title: House Architecture
holdings.purpose: Own active architecture research around Rooms, ownership, topology, interfaces, projections and migration before constitutional promotion.
holdings.boundary: Research design remains provisional until promoted into constitutional/governance owners.

holdings.title: Open Questions & Hypotheses
holdings.purpose: Own unresolved questions, candidate explanations and explicit uncertainty queues.
holdings.boundary: Indexing a hypothesis does not promote it to canon.

holdings.title: Experiments & Formalization
holdings.purpose: Own experimental designs, candidate formal models, prototypes and test-oriented synthesis awaiting review.

featured_holdings.kind: specialist celestial mechanics, CMB, QCD and spin reference expansion

holdings.boundary: Experimental/formal elegance is not evidence without appropriate observation or validation.

holdings.title: Research Programmes
holdings.purpose: Own coordinated multi-Room research programmes, workstreams, source ledgers and promotion plans.

featured_holdings.kind: whole-project research depth audit and priority programme

holdings.boundary: A Programme coordinates work but does not steal fact ownership from participating Rooms.
